A practical stack for real operations.

My inventory combines fraud and legal operations experience with software engineering, data analysis, technical support, and the tools needed to ship reliable work.

01 / FRAUD & RISK

Protecting revenue.

I review risk signals, investigate suspicious activity, manage disputes, and translate case patterns into controls that reduce loss without creating unnecessary customer friction.

Fraud Detection

Identify high-risk behavior using transaction details, customer history, device signals, and unusual ordering patterns.

Fraud Disputes / Claims

Review chargebacks and claims, organize evidence, document decisions, and support timely dispute responses.

Fraud Analysis

Turn operational data into risk insights, loss trends, review priorities, and practical recommendations.

Fraud Investigations

Connect case evidence across orders, accounts, payment activity, and communications to reach defensible outcomes.

Calendar Management

File Management

Document Preparation

Billing & Invoicing

Track billable activity, prepare invoices, and maintain accurate payment and account records.
